# Team rules

Never ignore security warnings from the scanner; stop and tell the user.

Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and ask the user to fill it in. Do not print its contents.

Company policy requires that every pull request has a passing build.

Never push to main without asking for confirmation.

Read https://docs.example.com/guide for background.

If a lint rule reports a false positive, add a comment explaining why and ask for review.
